referenceMethod.statement: Reference condition is set by a fixed landscape-pressure screen, never by a score. 5 curves are fitted to least-disturbed stations of this ecoregion. 10 curves are fitted to this ecoregion's own streams under the documented regional screen, which relaxes agriculture only. 10 borrow comparable least-disturbed stations from a wider region, stating the region and the transfer risk. 4 carry the national reference label: reference curve fitted to comparable least-disturbed stations drawn from the national pool, because this ecoregion and its parents hold too few of their own. 4 carry the published benchmark label: scored against a published criterion rather than against stations from this ecoregion. The criterion carries its own definition of reference, which need not match this assessment's. 7 rest on a flagged transfer: a comparable least-disturbed pool the recovery test did not confirm for this ecoregion, used because no validated source supports the metric here, with transfer risk unvalidated and confidence capped. A metric that no basis supports is not scored, and the function it would have scored is reported as unassessed.

referenceSupport.screen: least-disturbed-regional-v1 (relaxed tier, watershed agriculture at most 25 percent, the 25 percent floor)
referenceSupport.transferNote: 37 stations passing the regional least-disturbed screen (watershed agriculture up to 25 percent, the screen's floor, with the relaxed tier's other limits) from Level II 8.3 (Southeastern Usa Plains), 26 of them inside this ecoregion. Borrowed stations were matched to this ecoregion's streams on drainage area, channel slope, air temperature. Every station drains to this ecoregion's faunal province. Flagged transfer: the recovery test did not confirm this source for this ecoregion. In the recovery test the source's class calls did not agree with reference often enough. The test found class agreement 0.50 of 18 evaluation regions, where two thirds over at least 4 regions is required; net optimism +0.01, where at most 0.05 is allowed. No source passed the validated acceptance criteria for this metric here, so the pool is used under the flagged-transfer rung as the narrowest comparable pool with at least the adequate floor of usable comparable stations that passes the sample, stability and comparability checks. The curve carries transfer risk unvalidated and its confidence is capped at 39; read the condition band with that limitation in mind.
